title: Canonical tensor integration comparison equations
statement:
For the finite Tate coefficient coordinates and a vector bundle over a Noetherian base where the prime is invertible, define the predicate of compatibility for a bounded constructible finite-Tor coefficient K. It requires inverses of the actual ordinary and pro-etale coefficient-first projection maps, equality of their canonical comparison square, equality of the integration arrows fixed by inverse projection followed by tensor trace and the unitor, and equality of their ordinary and bounded-etale-origin adjunction transposes under the canonical rho comparison. The ordinary adjunct is invertible and, after the canonical signed swap from coefficient-first to twist-first source coordinates, equals the component of the independently integration-normalized family of [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization] used in [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity]. Every arrow is fixed by these defining formulas; no arbitrary map is used.

Use the recorded objects and canonical maps of [def-pur-conventions] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section] [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map] [def-amb-p1-trace] [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] [def-amb-vector-integration] [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace] [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity] [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent] [def-sp-p1-comparison-arrows] [lem-kun-tensor-sym] [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization] [def-pur-open-site-comparison-arrows] [def-pur-bounded-site-transpose-arrows] [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction] [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates] [def-pur-supported-projective-chern] [def-pur-supported-projective-site-arrows] [def-pur-finite-site-tensor-projection] [def-pur-proetale-projective-coefficient] [def-pur-proetale-projection-integration] [def-pur-proetale-affine-line-counit] [def-pur-proetale-ordered-integration] [def-pur-proetale-frame-integration] [def-pur-proetale-vector-integration] [def-pur-proetale-vector-integration-arrows]. The ordinary bundle compact-support, adjunction, twisted-pullback and projection coordinates are those of [def-pur-vector-integration-adjunction-arrows].
